answer: Each identity completes a three-link challenge chain across lagoon stations: every link needs a fresh yarrow sprig bound with a pearl seal. Auditors replay the chain table; a reused seal, shared station, or misordered link burns the 70-credit bond. First chain 90, kth 90+6(k-1); 1,000 chains cost 3,087,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented chains fail: one chain per station per epoch. An honest agent finishes one chain for 90 and keeps the bond.
